title: DevX SDK scratchpad - docs fixes & sample apps
content:
Quick notes from morning triage and hands-on with sample apps.

Context:
- Running through the SDK quickstart and the new sample app (chat-with-embeddings). Found some doc gaps and tiny bugs.
- Goal: ship a small patch release to docs + sample app by end of week.

High-level issues observed:
1) Quickstart (Python)
   - Code block for async streaming uses `await client.stream(...)` but our SDK uses `client.stream(...).__anext__()` in examples elsewhere -> inconsistent.
   - Missing mention of `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var and how to set up in Windows (PowerShell example).

2) Sample app: chat-with-embeddings (node)
   - Embedding code uses `embedClient.create({ model: 'rwd/embedding-v1', input: text })` but actual param name is `inputs` (plural) in lib v0.14. Breaks on run.
   - README says to run `npm run start` but package.json has `dev` script instead.

3) Tutorials and screenshots
   - Screenshots for Console have old UI (left nav shows "Projects" not "Workspaces"). Need updated images or remove.

4) Error handling / retries section
   - Docs lack a clear recommended retry/backoff pattern for transient 429/503. Add a small snippet using the sdk retry util (if available) or a pattern with exponential backoff.

5) Function calling example
   - We show a plain JSON schema example in TS but no working Python equivalent. Add both.

Quick TODO (priority ordered):
- [ ] Fix Python quickstart streaming snippet (remove conflicting patterns) — @Samantha for review — RDW-1287 (in progress)
- [ ] Add PowerShell env var example (Windows) to quickstart — quick update, low risk
- [ ] Patch node sample app: change `input` -> `inputs`, update README script reference — file: samples/chat-with-embeddings/index.js — (high) — linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/342
- [ ] Replace outdated console screenshots or add note to avoid screenshot drift
- [ ] Add small "retries" subsection under SDK error handling with code in both Python/TS (include backoff suggestion)
- [ ] Add Python function-calling example mirroring TS example (include structured outputs)
- [ ] Add short automated test (CI) to run sample app build + smoke run (catch the inputs->inputs bug earlier)

Notes to self / fragments:
- For streaming: check existing examples in docs repo: docs/sdk/streaming.md (might be duplication)
- When updating quickstart, keep the code minimal — 6–8 lines; link to full examples repo for deeper dive
- Consider adding a short "Common gotchas" section at bottom of quickstart (env, version mismatch, node/npm differences)

Possible follow-ups / owners:
- Samantha Lee: review quickstart edits + screenshots (assign)
- Devon Kim: patch sample app + open PR (has local env)
- Me (Isabel): write retries section + add Python function-calling snippet

Links / refs seen while testing:
- GH sample app: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/tree/main/chat-with-embeddings (note: local clone ahead)
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/342 (contains failing test initially)
- Jira: RDW-1287 (quickstart inconsistencies)
- Slack thread: #devx-sdk quickstart (thread ts: 2026-03-05 09:12)

Draft commit message for docs PR:
"docs(sdk): clarify quickstart streaming patterns, add Windows env example, and small retries note

- Align async streaming snippets across Python/TS
- Add PowerShell example for setting REDWOOD_API_KEY
- Add small section recommending retry/backoff strategy for transient 429/503"

Open questions (resolve before ship):
- Do we want to include an SDK retry util in lib, or just document pattern? (ask platform infra)
- Is there a supported minimum SDK version to call out in quickstart? currently README says >=0.12 but samples use v0.14 features. Might tighten to >=0.14.

Next steps (today):
1) Patch node sample app locally, run smoke test, push PR (Devon)
2) Draft quickstart edits (me) and ping Samantha for review
3) Draft retries snippet + Python function-calling example (me)
4) Add small CI smoke test for samples repo (follow-up)

Rough ETA: aiming for docs + sample fixes merged by Fri 2026-03-06 EOD. If blockers (infra/design), scope down to quickstart + sample app fix only.

Notes-to-self: keep edits atomic (one PR per concern):
- PR 1: quickstart text + examples (Python/TS)
- PR 2: sample app fix + CI smoke test
- PR 3: screenshots / console image update (if required)

Scratchpad ended. Will convert to task tickets after initial PRs created.
